raw_blocks: CELEBRATING NATIONAL WOMEN’S HISTORY MONTH: RECOGNIZING THE WOMEN WHO KEEP AMERICA MOVING

March is National Women’s History Month, a time to celebrate the achievements, resilience, and leadership of women across every industry. In transportation, where strength, precision, and grit meet strategy and innovation, women are not just participating, they are leading, shaping, and transforming the future of trucking.
At Marten, we are especially proud to recognize the incredible women across our organization who keep freight moving safely and efficiently every single day.
Women in Trucking: Driving Change in the Industry

Women In Trucking Association (WIT) has played a pivotal role in increasing gender diversity across transportation. From professional drivers and dispatchers to safety leaders, executives, and logistics experts, women are expanding their footprint in every segment of the industry.
Trucking has historically been male-dominated, but that narrative is changing. Today, women are:
Operating equipment with precision and professionalism
Leading safety and compliance initiatives
Negotiating contracts and driving business growth
Serving in executive leadership roles
Their impact isn’t incremental — it’s transformational.
Marten Recognized as a Top Place for Women to Work in 2025
We are proud that Marten has been recognized as a Top Company for Women to Work for in Transportation in 2025 by the Women In Trucking Association.
This recognition reflects more than a title, it represents our culture.
At Marten, we are committed to:
Providing equal opportunity for advancement
Recognizing leadership and performance at every level

From our professional drivers to operations, safety, finance, sales, and executive leadership, women across Marten play a critical role in our success. Their expertise, dedication, and leadership strengthen our organization and elevate the service we provide to our customers.
Honoring the Legacy and Building the Future
National Women’s History Month reminds us that progress is built on courage, the courage to step into new roles, challenge norms, lead teams, and raise standards.
The women of Marten embody that spirit every day.
As we celebrate this month, we extend our gratitude to:
The women who paved the way in transportation
The next generation who will redefine what’s possible
Transportation is evolving. Leadership is evolving. And at Marten, opportunity is open to all who are ready to drive forward.
To the women of Marten and to women across the trucking industry, thank you for your strength, professionalism, and the example you set.
Happy National Women’s History Month.

pages.raw_meta: Our journey spans from innovative solutions to sustainable milestones, ensuring a greener future in every mile. At Marten, sustainability is built into everyday decisions. Progress happens through hundreds of operational choices made across our fleet, facilities, and network, all guided by a steadfast commitment to a greener environment and being a responsible partner for our…
raw_blocks: DRIVING A GREENER FUTURE: MARTEN’S COMMITMENT TO SUSTAINABILITY

Our journey spans from innovative solutions to sustainable milestones, ensuring a greener future in every mile . At Marten, sustainability is built into everyday decisions. Progress happens through hundreds of operational choices made across our fleet, facilities, and network, all guided by a steadfast commitment to a greener environment and being a responsible partner for our customers and the communities in which we live. Our customers benefit from a carrier that invests in its people, equipment, and infrastructure with the future in mind.

Sustainability in Action. Real sustainability shows up in how work gets done. Over the past year, Marten made measurable improvements by focusing on the fundamentals, such as refining operations, eliminating waste, and making smarter use of resources already in place. For example, teams across the organization worked to reduce unnecessary fuel consumption by tightening operational practices and improving how equipment is utilized day-to-day.

Smarter Fleet Decisions, Every Day. Rather than relying on a single solution, Marten focused on incremental improvements across the fleet. This included more disciplined equipment deployment, better alignment between freight characteristics and equipment, and thoughtful lifecycle management of tractors and trailers. Over time, these decisions added up to a fleet that moves freight more efficiently while reducing environmental impact, without compromising service or reliability.

Excellence Beyond the Fleet. Sustainability improvements also took place off the road. Marten optimizes opportunities to reduce energy usage through operational adjustments, improved scheduling, smart purchasing, and facility-level efficiencies. Since 2017, Marten has completed 18 solar projects, contributing to reduced purchased electricity demand and supporting our broader sustainability strategy. Our teams are focused on responsible resource management, including water conservation and used oil recycling practices that help reduce waste and support cleaner operations. These practical changes lowered electricity and resource consumption while maintaining productivity and supporting our day-to-day work environments, proving that sustainability and operational excellence go hand in hand.

Responsible Capacity, Thoughtfully Managed. Marten’s sustainability efforts extend beyond company-owned assets. Through more intentional planning and oversight of transportation services, we reduced emissions tied to network by focusing on right-sizing solutions and eliminating inefficiencies. Marten is committed to improved environmental performance while continuing to deliver dependable capacity for our customers.

Measuring What Matters. Every improvement is tracked, reviewed, and validated against recognized standards. Marten’s sustainability progress is measured using globally accepted greenhouse gas accounting frameworks, ensuring our results are credible, repeatable, and transparent.

Looking Forward. Our journey spans from innovative solutions to sustainable milestones, ensuring a greener future in every mile. The progress we’ve made reinforces a simple truth: sustainability isn’t about one big move, it’s about doing the right things consistently, over time.
STEADFAST COMMITMENT TO A GREENER ENVIRONMENT. At Marten, sustainability is how we operate today and how we prepare for tomorrow.
Learn more about Marten’s sustainability journey: https://www.marten.com/sustainability/

raw_blocks: MESSAGES OF THANKS: DISPATCHERS SHARE WHY MARTEN IS SO GRATEFUL FOR OUR DRIVERS

As Thanksgiving approaches, we’re reminded of the people who make this season—and every season—run smoothly. At Marten, that gratitude begins with our drivers. The long hours, the miles, the commitment to safety, the sacrifices made away from home—these actions fuel our success, our customers’ success, and the communities that rely on timely deliveries during the holidays.

To celebrate this season of thanks, we asked members of our dispatch team to share stories about the drivers they work with every day. Their messages tell the tale clearly: Marten drivers are exceptional.
“Drivers are the backbone of this company.” – Chad A. Christie

Now in his 15th year with Marten, Chad says the best part of his job has always been the drivers themselves. “I’ve always enjoyed building relationships and learning from them. Fifteen years ago, I had zero transportation experience—our drivers taught me what life is really like on the road.”

One of his favorite memories? Presenting Million Mile Safe Driving Awards. “If being on the road for one or two million miles and doing it safely isn’t above and beyond, I don’t know what is. It’s amazing to play even a small part in honoring their professionalism.”
Chad’s message of thanks: “Your hard work keeps this country moving. Through long hours and unpredictable weather, you deliver safely and professionally. Your sacrifices don’t go unnoticed.”
“Their teamwork was incredible.” – Ryan E. Cooper
Ryan has spent sixteen years supporting drivers as they grow their careers—and their dedication still impresses him.

Recently, he watched three drivers work together to keep freight moving in a challenging situation. One driver in Weed, CA, waited hours to relay a load, ensuring it could continue to Rice Hill, OR, for a third driver to finish. “All three loads arrived on time. Their teamwork was incredible.”
Ryan especially enjoys recognizing his Million Mile and Driver Mentor drivers with bomber jackets: “It’s an honor to present those awards.”
His message of gratitude: “We are most thankful for your commitment to safety and premier service. You are truly the top of the field, and it is our pride that you drive with us.”
“They show up and perform an extremely difficult job.” – Blake E. Baty

In his ten years with Marten, Blake says the trust between operations and drivers is what stands out most. “Our drivers work hard to execute the plans we put in place—maximizing their miles and getting them home to spend time with their families.”

One story he’ll never forget: a driver who prevented a trailer from being stolen by noticing something was off, calling dispatch, and confronting the unauthorized individual. “Her quick thinking protected our equipment and our freight.”
Another highlight was watching a driver he once managed grow from struggling early on to becoming one of the hardest-working, award-winning drivers on his board. “I consider him a friend for life.”
Blake’s message of thanks: “Thank you for showing up every day and doing a difficult job in the safest way possible. Your work ethic is unmatched.”
“They move Marten forward.” – Clint E. Talley
Clint has spent twelve years at Marten and says the most meaningful part of his job is getting to know drivers personally and helping them achieve their goals.

A recent example of a driver going above and beyond happened when last-minute trailers needed to be spotted over the weekend. “He had just delivered and was heading home. We called, explained the situation, and he enthusiastically said, ‘Yes!’”

His favorite memory goes back to his early career—coordinating an overnight load of crawfish from Louisiana to Nashville. “If it didn’t arrive in time, 22,000 people wouldn’t have crawfish. I worked with our best driver to create a plan. The next morning, it was sitting in Nashville. A cool moment.”
Clint’s message of thanks: “Thank you for everything you do. Your focus on safety and commitment to moving Marten forward will help us come out of this freight recession stronger than ever.”
Across every story, a few themes are consistent:

Sacrifice—time away from home, long hours, and unpredictable conditions. Teamwork—drivers stepping up for each other, customers, and operations. Professionalism—delivering safely, consistently, and with pride.

During the holidays, these efforts matter more than ever. Increased traffic, tighter schedules, and winter weather make the season challenging, yet Marten drivers continue to deliver so families across the country can celebrate with full tables and full shelves.
To every Marten driver: thank you. Your dedication keeps our customers moving, supports our communities, and makes Marten stronger every day.
We are grateful—this season and every season—to have the very best behind the wheel.

raw_blocks: MILES OF DEDICATION: CELEBRATING SAFE-DRIVING ACHIEVEMENTS ACROSS OUR FLEET

At Marten, outstanding driving is built one safe mile at a time. The Million Mile and Medallion Club Awards honor the drivers who exemplify consistency, safety, reliability, and commitment to delivering excellent service on the road. This fall, we proudly celebrated drivers across several events in Tucker, GA, Phoenix, AZ, and Mondovi, WI — recognizing milestones that represent years of professionalism and care.

Bronze Medallion – 8 Years Accident-Free We proudly recognized the following drivers for achieving eight years of accident-free performance: Walter “Wally” Mintus, Brandon Maughan, Jeffrey Torres, Andrei Dobrotka, James Swilling, Gary Emerson, and Reggie Williams. Thank you all for your consistent commitment to safe, reliable driving.

Silver Medallion – 12 Years Accident-Free Charles Shaeffer was recognized for maintaining 12 years of safe driving with Marten — an achievement built on long-term consistency and care on every route. Thank you, Charles.

Gold Medallion – 15 Years Accident-Free James Miller, with a combined 25 years at Marten, earned his Gold Medallion. His long-standing excellence reflects dedication to safety and strong service to our customers. Congratulations, James.
One Million Safe Mile Honorees

We proudly recognized the following drivers for reaching one million safe miles — a milestone representing years of professionalism, responsibility, and exceptional performance on the road: Bart Morris, Paul Fortney, Raymond Riley, Raymond Weeks, Johnny Jewell, Paul Wisner, Edward Theall, Ted Zaczkiewicz, Joshua Stansbury, Donald Soderstrom, Jeffrey Winks, Fernando Remedios, Guy De Marco, Steven King, Miguel Vega, Odion Jackson, Michael Lewis, and Frederick Sawyer.
Thank you all for your dedication to safe driving and for representing Marten with skill and pride.
Two Million Safe Mile Honorees
Reaching two million safe miles is an exceptional achievement. This year, we recognized:
David Peters, Dale Froman, Paul Wiese, Richard Roth, Robin Walker, Lance West, and Jason Reilly — each demonstrating long-term dedication to safety and excellence on the road.
Congratulations on this remarkable accomplishment and thank you for your continued leadership and skill.
Driver of the Year – Danny Reyes

We also proudly recognized Danny Reyes as Marten’s 2024 Company Driver of the Year. Danny’s attention to detail, safety record, customer service and positive attitude set him apart as a leader across our fleet.
Congratulations, Danny — and thank you for representing the very best of Marten.

To every driver honored this quarter: your work moves Marten, our customers, and the communities we serve. Thank you for the professionalism you bring to the road each day — and for demonstrating what safe, skilled driving looks like mile after mile.
Here’s to the road ahead — and the many milestones still to come. It will be a joy to celebrate these milestones with every driver in our fleet!

raw_blocks: OCTOBER IS NATIONAL CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS MONTH

October is National Cybersecurity Awareness Month, and at Marten Transport, we know that protecting customer freight starts long before it ever hits the road. In today’s connected world, cybersecurity and cargo security go hand in hand.
As both a carrier and broker, we take extra steps to keep our customers’ freight and information protected:
🔐 Secure carrier vetting – Every carrier we work with is verified through strict compliance and safety checks to prevent double brokering and cargo theft.
📦 Shipment visibility and monitoring – Real-time tracking, verified dispatch, and communication protocols help ensure freight stays where it’s supposed to be.
💻 Cyber safeguards – Strong passwords, multi-factor authentication, and encrypted systems protect shipment data and documents.
🚨 Loss prevention partnership – Our team actively monitors for red-zone areas, suspicious activity, and theft alerts to prevent issues before they happen.
🧠 Employee and driver training – Continuous training helps our teams recognize phishing scams, fraudulent load postings, and other cyber risks.
Cyber threats evolve, but so do we. Together, we can keep our networks, our people, and our freight secure on every mile.
🕸️ Read more of the Bluebird Beat at https://www.marten.com/bluebird-beat/
